basis: Article 1 of the original statutes calls it a private cultural foundation, article 29 has the board approve the budget and send it to the Protectorate, and the register entry lists later amendments.

The organization and statutes page says the centre is managed by a foundation whose board holds representatives of the Asturias government, Gijón City Council and Gijón Port Authority and approves the annual budget.
The legal notice PDF page 1 names Zabalaga Leku, S.L. as the company behind the Museo Chillidaleku site.

governance.parent: Consejería de Cultura, Turismo y Deporte de la Comunidad de Madrid

basis: Recital II of a Comunidad de Madrid convenio in the BOCM of 3 October 2025 says the museum is attached to the Consejería and was created by Decreto 38/2008 of the Consejo de Gobierno.

governance.parent: Ministerio de Vivienda y Agenda Urbana

basis: Real Decreto 1125/2023 article 1 attaches the state museum to the ministry, article 7 has the minister appoint and dismiss the director and article 7.2.e requires the ministry's authorisation for works leaving the museum.
The transparency page says the centre is run by Fundación Montemadrid, an independent non-profit organisation governed by its Board of Trustees.

governance.parent: Área de Cultura, Turismo y Deportes del Ayuntamiento de Madrid

basis: The Quiénes somos page describes it as a contemporary creation centre of the Área de Cultura, Turismo y Deportes of the Ayuntamiento de Madrid.

The 2025 annual accounts (pages 5 and 6) say the foundation was created by the Spanish State and belongs to the state public sector, and the board document (pages 2 and 3) has the Patronato approve the budget and name the artistic director.
